title: Mani and the Making of Manichaeism
dek: Of how a boy raised in a Jewish-Christian baptist sect in Mesopotamia built a world religion from Christian, Buddhist and Zoroastrian parts, and presented it to a Persian king.

panels.label: Manichaeans Told It
panels.text: Mani was the last of the apostles of light, sent after Zoroaster, the Buddha and Jesus to restore the truth their followers had corrupted.

panels.label: Evidence Allows
panels.text: Mani grew up among the Elcesaites, broke with them, borrowed from Christian, Buddhist and Zoroastrian teaching, and framed his faith for the Sasanian court.

caption: Historical document
